changelog:
Skill 108: Platform Engineering Fundamentals – initial release

- Introduces fundamentals of platform engineering for advanced practitioners.
- Covers developer experience metrics and anti-patterns.
- Details approaches to building internal platforms with self-service.
- Explains layered infrastructure abstraction and standards for Infrastructure as Code.
- Sets out best practices for observability as a built-in platform feature.
- Defines cost management and automated governance/compliance for platforms.
summary: Master platform engineering principles to build self-service internal platforms that optimize developer experience, infrastructure abstraction, observability...
